shortDescription: Manage network interfaces in a Everpure FlashArray

options.name: address
options.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of interface in CIDR notation. To remove an IP address from a non-management port use 0.0.0.0/0

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: enabled
options.description: State of the network interface

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: gateway
options.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of interface gateway.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: interface
options.description: Type of interface to create if subinterfaces is supplied

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: mtu
options.description: MTU size of the interface. Range is 1280 to 9216.

options.name: name
options.description: Interface name (physical or virtual).

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: servicelist
options.description: Assigns the specified (comma-separated) service list to one or more specified interfaces. Replaces the previous service list. Supported service lists depend on whether the network interface is Ethernet or Fibre Channel. Note that I(system) is only valid for Cloud Block Store.

options.name: state
options.description: State of existing interface (on/off).

options.name: subinterfaces
options.description: List of one or more child devices to be added to a VIF interface Only the 'eth' name needs to be provided, such as 'eth6'. This interface on all controllers will be assigned to the interface.

options.name: subnet
options.description: Name of the subnet which interface is to be attached

options.name: subordinates
options.description: List of one or more child devices to be added to a LACP interface Subordinates must be on the same controller, therefore the full device needs to be provided.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
